fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-flight) are a near-verbatim spread of a NewsArticle structured-data object extracted from a Next.js React-Server-Components flight payload (not a <script type="application/ld+json"> tag), so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear. Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap, Google News sitemap) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record: S1-flight or S2-sitemap.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. "not_found", "http_500", "blocked_or_transient").

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the flight-payload NewsArticle node. HTML entities (e.g. ') are unescaped.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article summary/dek from the flight-payload node.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full plain-text article content, resolved from a separate cross-chunk reference in the flight stream and HTML-entity-unescaped.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated topic tags, as emitted upstream.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline -- a list of Person objects (@type/name/url), passed through as-is.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image -- an ImageObject with url/height/width, passed through as-is.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher NewsMediaOrganization object (name, url, logo, sameAs), passed through as-is.

url.title: Canonical URL
url.description: Canonical article URL as emitted upstream.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode sitemap item (news:title). HTML entities are unescaped.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the sitemap item (latest-mode).

publication_date.title: Publication date
publication_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp from the sitemap item's news:publication_date (latest-mode). Entries are sorted by this field, descending.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
